 m=sum(x)/H;v=sum((xi-m)**2 for xi in x)/H;iv=1/math.sqrt(v+1e-5)

def li(x,w,b,inn,out):
 y=b[:]
 for i in range(inn):
  xi=x[i];base=i*out

 return y
def li_t(x,w,b,inn,out):
 y=b[:]
 for j in range(out):

 return y
